title: FR-10's first acceptance: a held bath's composition scheduled on the dt grid in the composite (scheduled_bath_composition@1), against independent references, with its records, ledgers, idleness, restart, batch and refusals
status: PROPOSED (drafted 17 November 2026 by the FR owner on branch fr10-protocol, from docs/BATH_SCHEDULE_DESIGN.md §4 restated against the operator as built in milestones 1 and 2, §7-§8). Not registered; registration is the lead's

rung: FR-10, acceptance 1 (numerical verification, D174's first claim kind; no living-cell claim)
question: Does scheduled_bath_composition@1 change a held bath's composition on the dt grid so that @3's transport and membrane see the new composition (a neutral species through a face chain against the matrix exponential with the stepped boundary; an ion substitution's membrane relaxation against an independent constant-field ODE), with every ledger closing across events (the energy ledger at rounding under RK4; the reservoir-work ledger closing only with the operator's reconciliation term), its records exact, the composition bitwise idle when nothing is scheduled, restart and batch bitwise, and every refusal of its declared scope holding?
engine_models: resolved_pump_composite@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3 (the composite and its inner model)
scheduled_bath_composition@1 (the operator: event map, view of extracellular_amount_reference, records, the reconciliation term K, the step rule)
constant_field@1 (the passive patch law of the ion world's K leak)
ideal_osmosis_linear_compliance_water@1 (water@1, in the water part only)
the IDs the judged definitions print are checked against this list when the generator exists (pre-registration)
scope: Neutral formula units only (a net-charged unit is refused, design §2.5). Held baths only (reservoir: true). Steps only inside the measured region: a step is admitted only if a measured passing point of its key (neutral species by class, ions by species ID) and direction dominates its ratio and level, under ARS(2,2,2) at dt <= 1 ms or RK4 at dt <= 0.1 ms, beside faces at kappa/V <= 10/s (bath_schedule.MEASURED_POINTS, design §8). Water@1 only with isosmotic steps (door W unbuilt). The verdict covers scheduled_bath_composition@1 and its MEASURED_POINTS as built at the judged snapshot; the region is expected to grow with new measurements, and each addition is outside this verdict

worlds.builders: validation/tissue/bath_schedule_fixtures.py (to be added there: the two-node chain, the ion world, the staircase, the water world and the refusal definitions; B2's ion world and the staircase now exist only in /mnt/workspaces/Cells/bath-schedule-20261114-01/m2-probes/probe_m2.py and staircase/staircase_probe.py, which stay as frozen run inputs)
worlds.W1_chain: B1's world: the species-only dose leg (secreted_species_fixtures' quiescent world: passive cells, zero ion permeability and diffusivity) with the neutral species S on a chain bath -face_0- ecs_0 -face_1- ecs_1, each node 1 pL, face_0 at kappa/V = 10/s (the measured face rate) and face_1 at 5/s; one inert cell. S starts at steady state, 1e-3 mM at every node and the bath. The schedule: S at the bath up tenfold to 1e-2 mM at 1 s, down tenfold to 1e-3 mM at 2 s; horizon 3 s; records every 10 ms. Both steps are the measured corner (10, 1e-2) (neutral up, neutral down)
worlds.W2_ion: B2's world: probe I's passive cell (1 pL) on a held bath at Na 145, K 5, Cl 150 mM, its cytosol at Na 10, K 140, Cl 20 mM, a K permeability of 5e-10 m/s on its wall, at rest at E_K through its charge anchor. At 0.5 s, KCl replaces NaCl by 45 mM: K 5 to 50 mM (the measured point K up (10, 50)), Na 145 to 100 mM (Na down (1.45, 145)). Horizon 2 s (about 20 relaxation times); records every 10 ms
worlds.W3_ledgers: B3's world (milestone 1's tests/unit/test_bath_schedule_runs.py world): the species-only dose leg under RK4 at 0.1 ms, S stepped from 1e-3 to 1.5e-3 mM at step 20 of 60 (neutral up (1.5, 1.5e-3)); every row recorded
worlds.W4_idle: B5's pair: W1 with the operator declared and no event, and W1 without the operator
worlds.W5_restart_batch: B6's: W1 run straight, and restarted through the engine's checkpoint (cells.io.write_snapshot and load_snapshot, written and resumed within the run's own snapshot, so no checkpoint crosses a source change, D195 item 4) from checkpoints at 0.5 s (before the first event), at 1 s (an event time: the event is applied once, by the resumed run) and at 1.5 s (after it); and a vector batch (cells.core.batch) of three W1 worlds with different schedules on the same bath (up tenfold; up threefold; none), against each run alone
worlds.W6_water: B8's: milestone 1's isosmotic salt step beside water@1 (KCl for NaCl, K 5 to 15 mM, Na 145 to 135 mM, the measured points K up (3, 15) and Na down (1.0741, 145)), and the same world with an anisosmotic step (KCl added alone)
worlds.W7_staircase: B10's admitted dose from the trace: the staircase probe's world (the dose leg, face at kappa/V = 10/s, S at 1e-15 mM everywhere), the bath raised to 1e-3 mM by six stairs of 100 held 0.3 s each, under ARS at 1 ms and RK4 at 0.1 ms
worlds.refusals: one representative per refusal class, each beside its admitted neighbour, which is admitted and run over a short horizon: the classes, representatives, neighbours and the check each refusal must name are refusal_classes

R1_past_a_neutral_corner.admitted: up from 1e-3 to 1e-2 mM, the corner (10, 1e-2)

R3_a_dose_from_nothing.admitted: W7's six stairs of 100 from 1e-15 mM

refusal_classes.mapping_rule: every refusal class of design §8.3 (R1 to R9) has a representative, each beside its admitted neighbour; R10 to R13 are the scope's other refusals (§1.1, §2.4, §2.5, §3.1). Each refusal is judged by the check its message names (J9), and each neighbour must be admitted and run

references.author: a fresh code-blind agent, the FR references agent, from the design's Appendix A and the registered input file only (never reading src/cells, the operator or its tests); it starts when one of the seven slots frees (the lead's ruling of 17 November 2026)
references.R_faces: A.2: the linear face chain with the stepped bath boundary, each epoch the matrix exponential with its constant boundary from the previous epoch's end; returns each finite node's amount (fmol) at the record times, with a floor run at a tighter tolerance
references.R_ion: A.3: the passive cell's constant-field K flux and capacitor, with the cytosol's amounts moving by the flux; returns V_m (cell less bath, V) and the cytosol's Na, K and Cl (fmol) at the record times, and the zero-current potential at the new composition, with a floor run
references.R_records: A.4 and A.5: at each event, the dose V_b sum_f delta_a_f nu_f and the free-energy change delta_G_b (§2.2's expression, in NumPy), and the reservoir-work reconciliation K from the supply series
references.event_convention: an event at t_e sets the boundary for t >= t_e (right-continuous): the engine applies it at the start of the step that starts at t_e. Node amounts and V_m are continuous at an event, so the references compare only those; the bath's held content is judged through the records (J6), not against a reference
references.inputs: validation/bath_schedule/reference_inputs.json, a registered file: each reference world's physical parameters, initial state, schedule and record times, the physical constants, and Appendix A's forms, written from the world builders' declarations, with no value taken from the operator's code

budgets.status: declared before any protocol run (the lead's ruling of 17 November 2026: declared first, as FR-4 and FR-5 did; the dt study reports against them as development)
budgets.B1: every finite node's S amount within 1e-3 of the step's size (V_node x |delta c_b| = 9e-3 fmol, so 9e-6 fmol) of R-faces at every record
budgets.B2: V_m within 1e-3 of the voltage step (|E_K(50) - E_K(5)| about 61.5 mV, so about 61.5 uV) of R-ion at every record; the cytosol's K within 1e-3 of its change
budgets.records: the dose within the operator's own dose-ledger tolerance of the held content less the declared one, and equal to R-records' dose at rounding; delta_G_b within 1e-12 relative of R-records
budgets.controls_margin: each control differs from its arm by at least 10 x the arm's budget on the same quantity

criteria.J1_admission: every run part admitted and run to its end with every host check on every row; every refusal part refused at the definition (J9)
criteria.J2_orders: the dt study's orders on the three finest rungs, for W1's two node amounts and W2's V_m and cytosol K, by FR-4's classes rule (resolved in [1.8, 2.2]; at rounding passes; mixed passes unless its lower bound exceeds 2.2; reversed fails)
criteria.J3_state_error: at the declared 1 ms, the Richardson-estimated error of W1's node amounts within B1's budget and of W2's V_m within B2's
criteria.J4_reference: W1 against R-faces within B1's budget, and W2 against R-ion within B2's, at every record at the declared 1 ms; row 0 equal at rounding; each reference's floor reported
criteria.J5_ledgers: W3 under RK4: the energy ledger within its absolute 2e-8 pJ bound at every row before, at and after the event, with the largest ratio of each segment reported; the reservoir-work ledger, with the operator's term, within its bound at every row. W1 and W2 under ARS: the energy residual over the integrated flows <= 2e-3 at the declared 1 ms, which is the coarsest rung, at every record, falling at second order down the ladder (the classes, no upper edge)
criteria.J6_records: at every event of W1, W2 and W3: the dose record within its ledger's tolerance of the held content less the declared content and equal to R-records' dose at rounding; delta_G_b within 1e-12 relative of R-records; the compensation-charge record at rounding of zero; the electrode and global-charge ledgers within their bounds at every row
criteria.J7_idle: W4: every state field, observation and diagnostic of the world with the operator and no event bitwise equal to the world without it, at every record
criteria.J8_restart_batch: W5: each restarted run bitwise equal to the straight run at every record after its restart, the event at the restart time applied once; each batched world bitwise equal to its run alone
criteria.J9_refusals: each refusal class's representative refused at the definition with the reason of its own check (refusal_classes), recorded from the refusal; each admitted neighbour admitted and run
criteria.J10_staircase: W7: the six-stair dose from the trace admitted and run with every host check under both solvers, while the same dose in one step is refused (J9)
criteria.J11_water: W6: the isosmotic step beside water@1 run with water's ledgers within their bounds at every row; the anisosmotic step refused (J9)
criteria.J12_controls: every control caught with its margin (controls)

controls.K1_no_step: W1 without its events: its node amounts differ from R-faces' stepped trajectory by at least 10 x B1's budget (the comparison sees a step)
controls.K2_no_step: W2 without its event: V_m differs from R-ion's by at least 10 x B2's budget
controls.K3_no_term: W3's reservoir-work ledger without the operator's term (@3's own, at the declared potential): within its bound before the event and at least 10 x its bound at every row after it (milestone 1 measured 2.1e4 x at the first)
controls.K4_one_ulp: W4's pair with the operator-free world's declared bath S changed by one ulp: not bitwise equal (the idle check sees one ulp)
controls.K5_moved_event: W5's restart at 1 s from a schedule whose event is moved one step later: not bitwise equal to the straight run (the restart check sees an event applied at the wrong step)
controls.K6_neighbours: each refusal's admitted neighbour (J9): a refusal check that refused everything would fail it

dt_study_criteria_written_first.note: the ladder can only go finer: with events, the step rule refuses ARS above 1 ms, so the declared rung is the coarsest; event and record times lie on the 1 ms grid. W3 is one RK4 rung (0.1 ms, the largest admitted); its claim is ledger closure, not an order
checks: admission of every rung (W1 and W2)
state error at the declared 1 ms, as J3
energy residual over flows <= 2e-3 at the declared 1 ms, which is the coarsest rung, falling at second order down the ladder (J5's ARS line)
dt_study_criteria_written_first.verdict: the declared 1 ms stands if every check holds; otherwise the arm declares the finest rung that passes, reported, not repaired

harness_limits: A part ended by its runtime limit or its memory cap (as by any other infrastructure ending: a signal, an incomplete results.json) is a harness failure, not a verdict: the judged run is void and is relaunched once, whole, from the same snapshot under the same protocol, into a new output directory; the void attempt is kept and reported beside the relaunch's verdict. A second harness failure goes to the lead. A refusal by the engine is a verdict, never a harness failure
recording_rules: Keep the bath's held content (the operator's state) apart from @3's tissue: the dose and its free-energy change are records, never work fields (design §2.2)
Keep the reconciliation term K apart from @3's reservoir_work_pJ: K is the operator's own ledger term (design §2.3)
Each refusal part records the message and the check it names; a refusal is judged by its reason, not by its occurrence
reported_not_judged: crossrev with the operator not declared: a landing gate, reported (design §4 B5's second half)
compile time, memory and cost per step
what_it_does_not_show: a net-charged step, a step outside the measured region, a dose from nothing in one step (each refused)
an osmotic (anisosmotic) step, which waits for door W
faster faces, other ions or directions, or solvers and steps outside the region
outcome_rules: PASS when J1-J12 hold; otherwise the failing criteria are reported with their values, without repair or retuning after the judged run

runs.status: milestone 1's gates: the smoke, B3 (the ledgers across an event under RK4, with the term-dropped control) and B5 (idleness); crossrev's five sets identical

questions_answered: 1. References: RULED (the lead, 17 November 2026): a fresh code-blind agent writes R-faces, R-ion and R-records from Appendix A, and later FR-3's references, as one FR references agent, starting when a slot frees; the FR owner prepares its inputs as registered files

disclosures: Drafted on 17 November 2026 after milestones 1 and 2 and their probes, whose results are known: B3's ledger record, the staircase probe and probes I and D (development_runs). Design §4's table predates milestone 2, so its items are restated against the operator as built: B10's dose from nothing is now refused at the definition in every world by the step rule, so a mixed world can no longer run it, and B10 judges that refusal and the admitted six-stair protocol instead; B1's 'step ratio pinned at registration' becomes the measured corner (10, 1e-2), up and down; B2's tenfold K step is probe I's measured point K up (10, 50) with Na down (1.45, 145); B9's parse refusals and B7's bound are judged as refusal parts that write records, not as test files, so no guard test of record can change under a later pass; B5's crossrev half is a landing gate, reported
